channel.title: Matterworm blog
channel.description: Progress, results, mistakes and plans from the Matterworm Foundation, the creator of the open Matter project.

item.title: Thirteen platforms, one set of answers
item.description: The same exam on Linux, macOS, Windows, three BSDs, WebAssembly, and 32-bit and big-endian machines: identical answers, different math libraries, and one system that did not work.

item.title: An exam any system can take, and two mistakes it found in ours
item.description: The entry exam we built so any future version is judged the same way, the baby's scores on it, and two honesty mistakes of our own that only showed up when we changed the test.

item.title: How Matter began, and where it stands
item.description: The starting hunch, the first week of work, what the prototype does and does not show, and what comes next.
